int queens(int n, int row, int[] positions, int[] &first)
    if row == n
        if n == 8 and #first == 0
            first = positions
        return 1
    count := 0
    for: column < n
        valid := true
        for: previous < row
            difference := positions[previous] - column
            if difference == 0 or difference == row - previous or -difference == row - previous
                valid = false
                break
        if valid
            positions[row] = column
            count += queens(n, row + 1, positions, &first)
    return count

int[] first := []
for: 4 <= n <= 8
    positions := array(nat(n), fill = -1)
    count := queens(n, 0, positions, &first)
    println("N={n}: {count} solutions")
for column := first[]
    println("." * nat(column) + "Q" + "." * nat(7 - column))
